in-axinella-tree-sponge.title: Red Tree Sponge
in-axinella-tree-sponge.summary: A branching red sponge that filters fine food from the water. It needs shade, steady flow and a mature tank rich in dissolved food.
rows: Filter feeder: fine particles and phytoplankton
notes: Place it in a shaded spot with moderate to strong flow.
Never expose it to air when moving it: air can block its pores.
